entry_points.text: Single-range advice on the caller space with start, length and behavior, delegating to the single-range implementation.
Vector advice on a task by descriptor with zero flags, vector import, task and space resolution under read ptrace permission, remote validation, and full release.
File control supports add-seals and get-seals commands, delegating to dedicated helpers and rejecting others.
Anonymous file creation by name and flags with huge or shmem backing, security init, mode and seal adjustment, descriptor install; shmem setup forwards to internal constructor.
Module init registers the memfd live-update handler, treating unsupported operation as benign and propagating other failures with diagnostic.

exports.text: Isolates driver movable pages only with folio backing, movable-ops marker, nonblocking folio lock, no prior isolated flag and driver acceptance, then core sets isolated.
RCU lookup returning the read-locked VMA covering an address in a space, else null; detached entries retry from the map internally.
Single-range advice validates behavior and range, takes behavior lock with TLB batch, walks VMAs updating subranges and neighbors.
Anonymous VMA naming over aligned ranges with bounded validated user names; bounded user copies report empty, fault, over-limit and alloc failures distinctly.
Shared file range helpers hold mapping read protection across page walks for write-protect or clean-record, clipping per VMA and returning totals and bounds.
Virtual free releases mappings; minimal build delegates to heap free, full build handles null, unknown areas, direct-map restore, pages and metadata, with atomic deferred path.

hazards.text: Concurrent VMA free, replacement and cross-space migration are tolerated; detached retries, unobtainable aborts for accounting, mismatched coverage releases and reports absent, other space pinned across drops.
Foreign-space advice is limited to a narrow remote subset and needs niceness privilege; same-space bypasses both, with read ptrace checks avoiding layout leaks.
Huge middle and upper entries are never split and warn when writable or dirty; overlapping policy insertion is fatal; mapping walk failures warn yet return totals.

Full-range pinning materializes gaps, forcing dirty trades reclaimability for correctness while avoiding movable hazards; oversize and unknown seals rejected; inode numbers warn on exhaustion; blocking free must defer in interrupt, NMI forbidden, unknown areas warn, direct maps poisoned before flush.

Always-available advice covers dofork, dontfork, normal, sequential, random, remove, willneed, dontneed, locked dontneed, free, cold, pageout, populate read and write, dontdump, dodump, wipeonfork, keeponfork, guard install and remove, plus mergeable pair with merging, hugepage trio with THP, and offline pair with failure support; remote allows only cold, pageout, willneed and collapse.

Anon names allow eighty bytes with termination and printable ASCII minus backslash, backtick, dollar and brackets, null clearing; pin scans bound at index four near one hundred fifty ms; pinned tag aliases towite; seal and flag aggregates and memfd colon prefix with suffix bound complete the set.

Persistence flags map noatime, append and immutable with nodump mapping to nothing and casefold in mask; cloexec maps to descriptor cloexec with standard allocation errors; preservation marks every folio dirty and uptodate within seal bounds and compat id with file-size limit; virtual flags control permission reset and accounting with fixed log prefixes.

invariants.text: Poison and soft-offline denote failure injection bypassing normal locks and traversal; without support the classifier is negative and injection succeeds trivially.
TLB batch arms only for dontneed variants and free; ranges need aligned start and rounded length with wrap and empty-after-round rejected; only populate uses populate path with untag and plug.
Scans convert writable to write-protected and dirty to clean via paired transactions, widening flush intervals and counts, with cleaning setting bitmap and dirty span.
Walk processes only shared possibly-writable areas, skips hugetlb, leaves huge upper entries unsplit with warning, clips page offsets to addresses and skips empties.
Folio is pinned when refs differ from expected; seals live in shmem or hugetlb inode state; write-sealed means write or future-write seal, shared writable rejected, private ignored.
Flags reject unknown bits, huge encoding only with huge request, and exec plus noexec together, then sysctl defaults apply; names carry fixed prefix with bounded suffix.
Shmem construction rejects bad mounts and bad sizes, accounts unless noreserve with rollback, creates unlinked regular inode and wraps as read-write pseudo file.
Shared policy starts empty; default means no policy, preferred-empty maps to local, local forbids mask and flags, masks fold onto allowed nodes, nodes order by start then end and abort on overlap.

Regular mounts enforce inode quota with sequential numbers skipping zero and wrap handling; internal mounts use per-CPU batches; policy fetch copies under lock; flags translate persistence bits with folding checks.
Creation sanitizes flags before naming and propagates only cloexec to the descriptor; preservation needs unlinked shmem file with identity from inode address.
Full free forbids NMI, allows sleep, tolerates null, warns on unknown, resets direct permissions when flagged, then frees pages and metadata; minimal build matches observably.

locks.text: Isolation takes folio lock nonblocking before any step, holds across checks and driver callback, releases on all paths and drops the entry ref even when freed beneath.
Failure injection takes no lock; removal, willneed, cold, pageout, collapse and populate take read lock; guard discard hints use deferred per-VMA reads; rest take killable write lock.
Per-VMA read suffices only for single-VMA caller ranges without userfaultfd or missing anon state; fast path tries RCU acquire at start else falls back to read lock.
VMA read pairs pre-check of VMA against space sequence with limited acquire refcount increment, ownership validation and second acquire check; false locked possible, false unlocked not.
PTE updates use start-commit pairs per VMA and address; pre-scan resets flush bounds and opens notifier with cache flush, post-scan flushes tracked range; mapping read held across walks.
Pin scans hold irq-protected xarray state, mark non-value entries with extra refs, and periodically pause, release, yield and reacquire to bound latency, including marked-only wait scans.
Superblock free space, sequence, width mode and policy sit under a raw spinlock across reserve, free and referenced policy fetch; inode creation initializes then allocates quota with unwind.
Alias purge serializes on a mutex with per-block spinlocks under RCU; folio fixups hold folio locks; live-update prepare and cancel hold inode lock; deferred free uses lockless insertion.

state_machines.text: Traversal tries optional single-VMA path, locates first overlap, records mapping errors on gaps yet continues, aborts on per-VMA errors, drops caches on lock loss, extends on split or merge until end.
Vector advice holds one lock and batch across segments, validates each independently, drops and reacquires on restart without fatal signals, returns bytes on progress else last error.

Both walk tables share directory, test, pre and post handlers and differ only at leaves; seal addition checks writability and known bits, serializes, expands exec seal, denies writable mappings for new write seal, waits for pins with rollback.

Pin waiting tags candidates then scans up to fixed passes, draining first then sleeping with growing delay, clearing unpinned marks, aborting sleeps to final pass, reporting busy only on survivors and always clearing final marks.

Preservation samples size with empty yielding nothing, else estimates folios, pins full range excluding movable and faulting gaps, then preserves each folio forcing dirty and up-to-date with location; outer step freezes inode and captures position, size and seals with reverse unwind.

Freeze refreshes saved position; unpreserve unfreezes and releases records; finish discards unclaimed folios on failure; discard restores pages transiently; retrieval validates seals, rebuilds file and inserts folios with charging, cache, accounting and reclaim, retaining inserted pages on error.

structs.text: Write-protect carrier holds notifier range, flush bounds and total; cleaning extends it with bitmap placement, storage and result bounds via container linkage.

New shmem inodes get reserved number, identity, zero blocks, fresh times, zeroed private state with locked lists and eviction controls, sealing defaults and type ops; offset context reachable by container.

Virtual areas carry flags, counts, page arrays and huge order; superblocks carry lock, quota, free space, sequence, width, batches and policy; preservation records carry position, size, seals and folio entries; live-update binds ops table with compat id.
